provenance: Hand-authored memo + matrix synthesizing the CAR-T curious LN persona's post_trial stage (corpus-evidenced at 6mo and 1yr) with structural projections for the 12-year LTFU tail. Corpus citations point to fragment-corpus 2026Q1 LN/CAR-T community thread.

memo.headline: Friction compounds where life does, not where biology fails.
memo.body: Retention through the ~12-year LTFU tail for autoimmune CAR-T won't be lost to the drug. It will be lost where the four pillars erode at different rates: emotional valence bifurcates as cohort outcomes diverge, logistical capacity compounds as caregivers and employers churn, provider trust erodes through handoffs and PI rotation, and the medical rationale for sustained visits fades as patients feel cured. The wise question is not what the friction is — it is which proxy population (oncology CAR-T survivors, hemophilia gene-therapy cohorts) the client accepts as evidence for year 8 and beyond.

possible_interventions.label: The "Digital Tether" approach
possible_interventions.body: Years 3–12 do not require expensive site visits. Propose a highly automated, digital-first LTFU framework — telehealth, local lab blood draws, ePRO (electronic Patient-Reported Outcomes) for fatigue and mobility metrics. Frame this as a way to keep costs ultra-low while keeping data completeness ultra-high.

possible_interventions.label: Site-to-community shared care blueprints
possible_interventions.body: Position the team as experts who provide "transition bundles" for the patients' community neurologists. If the local doctor understands the value of the 12-year data, they will ensure the patient stays in the protocol.

possible_interventions.label: Preventing "DMT Creep"
possible_interventions.body: Propose an early-warning system within the LTFU tracking to catch patients who are considering jumping back onto standard B-cell depleting therapies at the first sign of a minor symptom, protecting the purity of the CAR-T efficacy data.
